_comment: The tuner's starting config. The container copies this to /config/config.json the first time it starts, if that file isn't there, and never overwrites it after. scripts/build_channels.py fills in `channels`. Paths are as seen INSIDE the container. Every key is explained in config.example.json.
_channels: Written by scripts/build_channels.py: channel number -> station network_name. You can also add your own. A station that doesn't exist yet just shows as off air.
_advertise_url: Only used by Jellyfin/HDHomeRun clients, through lineup.json. Set it to this host's real address if you use one. The web portal does not use it.
